title: TRICARE Premium-Based Plans Cost-Share Schedule
content:
Claims under the **TRICARE Premium-Based Plans** are priced with the tier's own cost-share keys. A key is the sponsor's entry group (Group A or Group B) followed by the sponsor's pay-grade band (E-1 to E-4, or E-5 and above) or by "retiree". Deductibles and caps are amounts per calendar plan year; percentages are percent of the TRICARE allowed amount after the deductible.

## Keys each tier prices with

| Tier | Cost-share schedule | Keys |
|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-Only | plan keys by sponsor group and pay grade | Group A E-1 to E-4; Group A E-5 and above; Group B E-1 to E-4; Group B E-5 and above |
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family | plan keys by sponsor group and pay grade | same four keys |
| TRICARE Young Adult Select | plan keys by sponsor status, group and pay grade | the four pay-grade keys and Group A retiree; Group B retiree |
| TRICARE Young Adult Prime | plan keys by sponsor status, group and pay grade | the four pay-grade keys and Group A retiree; Group B retiree |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-Only | plan keys by sponsor group, retiree | Group A retiree; Group B retiree |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-and-Family | plan keys by sponsor group, retiree | Group A retiree; Group B retiree |

## Amounts by key (USD per calendar plan year, percent of allowed)

| Key | Individual deductible | Family deductible | Family catastrophic cap | Network outpatient cost share | Non-network outpatient cost share |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Group A, E-1 to E-4 | 50.00 | 100.00 | 1000.00 | 15% | 20% |
| Group A, E-5 and above | 150.00 | 300.00 | 1000.00 | 15% | 20% |
| Group B, E-1 to E-4 | 61.00 | 122.00 | 1252.00 | 0% | 20% |
| Group B, E-5 and above | 183.00 | 366.00 | 1252.00 | 0% | 20% |
| Group A, retiree | 150.00 | 300.00 | 3000.00 | 20% | 25% |
| Group B, retiree | 183.00 | 366.00 | 4034.00 | 0% | 25% |

The pay-grade rows apply to the TRICARE Reserve Select tiers and the TRICARE Young Adult tiers; the retiree rows apply to the TRICARE Retired Reserve tiers and the TRICARE Young Adult tiers. Every tier gives the same amounts for a key it carries.

Under every tier, premiums paid do not count toward the catastrophic cap.

## Example lookups (hypothetical)

- TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family, Group B, sponsor E-6: family deductible 366.00, family catastrophic cap 1252.00, non-network outpatient care 20% of allowed.
- TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-Only, Group A retiree: individual deductible 150.00, network outpatient care 20% of allowed, family catastrophic cap 3000.00.
